Class AsyncBatchGetBuilder<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T, AsyncBatchGetBuilder<T>>
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.async.AsyncBatchGetBuilder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
public class AsyncBatchGetBuilder<T> extends AbstractBatchGetBuilder<T, AsyncBatchGetBuilder<T>>
Builds an async batch get operation to retrieve multiple items from a single table by their keys.

Obtain via AsyncTable.batchGet(). Executes using the async enhanced client and returns a CompletableFuture that completes when all pages have been collected.

    • executeWithPagination

      public @NonNull CompletableFuture<PagedResult<T>> executeWithPagination()
      Executes the batch get operation and returns a single page of results along with any unprocessed keys.

      Since batch get does not use traditional cursor-based pagination, the last evaluated key is always null. If there are unprocessed keys, they are not automatically retried.

      Returns:
      a CompletableFuture containing a PagedResult with items from the first response page
